notes: The PDF for Bluebeam now carries each page's scale, so Bluebeam measures at the job's scale. A split dimension goes to Bluebeam as one length per piece. Right-click a page for Delete Page (asks first if there's takeoff on it; the drawing stays in the job folder, Ctrl+Z undoes it) and Export for Bluebeam… for just that page. Every pipe run shows its own length again, even where it touches another run.
